feed.title: Nimbrel Edge incident history
feed.subtitle: Resolved incidents affecting the Nimbrel Edge platform, newest first.

entry.title: Elevated relay latency on trans-Atlantic routes (Resolved)
entry.summary: NE-C214A: The carrier has restored the segment and latency on trans-Atlantic routes has been at its normal level for a full measurement window. Routes are back on their usual paths.

entry.title: Control panel sign-in errors (Resolved)
entry.summary: NE-77D02: The configuration push has been rolled back and sign-in has been normal since 15:14. No action is needed from customers; sessions that were already signed in were not affected.

entry.title: Relay mesh congestion in the Aparra region (Resolved)
entry.summary: NE-4B9E1: Spill capacity has absorbed the load and paths in the Aparra region have measured clean for a full window. Relay path checks now report the region as operational.

entry.title: API gateway elevated error rate (Resolved)
entry.summary: NE-05F1B: The affected cache node has been reprovisioned and error rates on the API gateway have been normal for a full window.

entry.title: Scheduled maintenance: relay firmware rollout (Completed)
entry.summary: NE-E60D3: The firmware rollout is complete on every relay. No customer-visible impact was recorded.

entry.title: Control panel slow page loads (Resolved)
entry.summary: NE-1A9C4: Page loads in the control panel have been inside two seconds for a full window. The query that caused the slowdown now runs against a new index.

entry.title: DNS propagation delay for new zones (Resolved)
entry.summary: NE-B7730: New zones are propagating to every site within their normal window. Zones created during the incident have all propagated.
